UNVERIFIED_fields_in_this_template: geometry.std 'box' - NOT shown in README first-scene example (only sphere and grid are shown). Plausible by analogy, must confirm with `vork help field geometry` / `vork help` on a GPU machine before trusting a render.
geometry.std 'prism' (gable roof) - UNVERIFIED, same reason. If unsupported, replace the roof node with two thin 'box' slopes or a .glb asset.
geometry.std 'cylinder' (tree trunk) - UNVERIFIED, same reason. If unsupported, omit the trunk node; the sphere canopy alone still reads as a tree.
geometry.size on 'box' / 'prism' nodes - the field name 'size' is VERIFIED for grid, but its meaning on box/prism ([width,height,depth] assumed here) is UNVERIFIED.

light.shape 'sun' - UNVERIFIED. Only 'rectangle' is shown in the README. Confirm with `vork help field light.shape` before relying on it; the rectangle light in this template is the verified fallback.
Any material input other than base_color and specular_roughness (for example metallic, roughness maps, textures) - UNVERIFIED here. Confirm with `vork help field material.inputs`.

Any node field not listed above (rotation, scale, name, etc.) - NOT USED in this template, because it is not shown in the README excerpt. Do not add one without checking `vork help field <path>` first.
_meta.coordinate_note: UNVERIFIED: axis orientation / which axis is up is not stated in the README excerpt. This template follows the first-scene example, where a grid at translation [0,-1,0] sits below a sphere at the origin, so Y is treated as up and ground is at y = -1. Confirm on first render and flip if the house is floating or buried.
_meta.name: Custom 3D Property Model - house scene template
_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE ONLY. generate_scene.py reads this structure, substitutes intake values, and strips every key starting with '_' before writing the renderable scene JSON. Do NOT pass this file directly to `vork render` - remove the _meta and _slots objects first, or use generate_scene.py.
_meta.source: https://github.com/voyager-so/vork README first-scene example (examples/first-scene.json) + glTF asset example
_meta.units: Metres in scene space. generate_scene.py converts intake square feet to metres (1 ft = 0.3048 m). Footprint side = sqrt(total_sq_ft / stories) in feet, then converted.
verified_fields_used: mesh.geometry.std: sphere (radius) / grid (size) - shown in README first-scene example
light.shape: rectangle, light.translation, light.target, light.energy, light.size, light.color
_meta.gltf_option: OPTIONAL: replace the box/prism house nodes with a real .glb house model when one exists. README asset example is {"type":"asset","file":"model.glb"} plus a light and camera. Keep the .glb and its textures/buffers beside the scene JSON. A missing file will fail the render, so do not add an asset node until the file exists.

_slots.added_sq_ft: intake.added_sq_ft - drives addition_width_m / addition_depth_m (0 = omit the addition node)
_slots.address: intake.address - informational only, not a vork field
_slots.camera_preset: intake.camera_preset (orbit | aerial | street | backyard | interior) - drives camera translation/target
_slots.existing_sq_ft: intake.existing_sq_ft - drives house body size before the addition
_slots.lighting_preset: intake.lighting_preset (day | dusk | night) - drives sun/rect light energy and color
_slots.render_resolution: default [1280, 720]; use [640, 480] for previs smoke tests, [1920, 1080] for final
_slots.roof_type: intake.roof_type (gable | hip | flat) - gable = prism node below; hip/flat = replace prism with a flat box slab (UNVERIFIED, see _meta)
_slots.scope_addition: intake.scope contains 'addition' - include the addition node, else omit it
_slots.scope_adu: intake.scope contains 'adu' - include the ADU node, else omit it
_slots.stories: intake.stories (1 or 2) - drives house_height_m (3.0 m per story, plus roof)
_slots.style_preset: intake.style_preset (modern | farmhouse | craftsman) - drives paint/roof/trim palette only, via base_color

nodes._slot: lot ground - lawn green, grid size is the lot in metres
driveway - grey grid slab, front-right of house
house body - size [width_m, height_m, depth_m] from total_sq_ft / stories; base_color from paint_hex. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED - see _meta.
gable roof - prism sitting on top of house body; base_color from roof_hex. GEOMETRY 'prism' IS UNVERIFIED - see _meta. If unsupported, replace with a flat box slab or a .glb roof asset.
front window, left - thin box on front face. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED.
front window, right - thin box on front face. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED.
front door - thin box on front face. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED.
addition volume - OMIT this node if scope has no addition; size from added_sq_ft. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED.
detached ADU volume - OMIT this node if scope has no ADU; detached, back-left of lot. GEOMETRY 'box' IS UNVERIFIED.
tree trunk 1 - GEOMETRY 'cylinder' IS UNVERIFIED. Omit if unsupported; canopy alone still reads as a tree.
key light - rectangle, VERIFIED. Day preset values shown.
sun - SHAPE 'sun' IS UNVERIFIED (only 'rectangle' is shown in README). Confirm with `vork help field light.shape`. Omit this node if unsupported; the rectangle light above is the fallback.

camera - orbit preset. Aerial = [0, 22, 6]; street = [10, 2, 18]; backyard = [-12, 4, -14]; interior = [0, 2, 2] target [0, 2, -4] (interior framing is approximate until a real interior model exists - see customization-matrix.md).
